method: Compare official Anytype personal spaces/offline documentation with Notion page editing, and read vendor migration limitations. Documentary attributes are distinct from the bounded editorial alternative judgment. No hands-on test or publication approval.

sources.title: Anytype documentation — local-first personal spaces
sources.statement: Vendor describes device-first creation, fully offline work and personal spaces for diaries, tasks and documents.
sources.limitations: This does not establish complete Notion feature parity, no-account operation or privacy certification.

sources.title: Anytype documentation — local-first versus local-only
sources.statement: Standard local-first data works offline and reconnects for encrypted sync; optional local-only disables backup-node sync.
sources.limitations: Local-only is experimental; backup/export is manual and cross-device sync is limited to the local network.

sources.title: Anytype official documentation repository — memberships
sources.statement: The official repository documents a Free tier and paid plans expanding storage, shared channels and ANY ID entitlements.
sources.limitations: Exact prices/limits must be checked live; self-hosted limits and paid membership renewal consequences are separate.

sources.title: Anytype official documentation repository — Notion migration limits
sources.statement: The vendor documents a Notion import, while stating not all Notion features/data are supported.
sources.limitations: Mentions and date ranges can become text; formulas/summary results import as values, and some links/files may need repair. Import requires internet/API access; it is not an offline migration promise.

sources.title: Notion documentation — offline page use
sources.statement: All plans support creating pages and editing downloaded pages in desktop/mobile apps; offline availability is prepared per device/page.
sources.limitations: Browser access is excluded, subpages need separate preparation and some network-dependent blocks do not work offline. Do not describe Notion as lacking offline support.

claims.value: A Free tier and paid membership plans are available. Paid plans expand remote storage, shared-channel and ANY ID entitlements. Check current plan prices and limits; self-hosted configurations and renewals have separate terms.

Scope is personal notes and objects stored on the device, not full Notion parity. Normal local-first mode works offline and syncs when connected. Optional local-only mode is experimental and requires manual backups, with multi-device sync limited to the local network. Notion imports can lose feature semantics, links or files and need review.

alternativeStatement: Both products document personal content creation/organization. Anytype personal spaces and local objects provide a bounded offline note/document workflow; vendor migration guidance explicitly excludes full feature parity.
scopeDescription: Personal offline note and object organization only. Anytype local-first personal spaces after initial setup; synchronization and Notion import need connectivity. No guarantee of full Notion feature, team or migration parity. Local-only is a separate experimental mode with manual backup responsibility.
routeDescription: Compare offline-capable alternatives for personal notes and locally stored content. Notion also supports offline pages in desktop/mobile apps, with per-page and per-device preparation and feature limits. This comparison concerns different offline workflows, not a claim that Notion cannot work offline. Sync, collaboration, initial setup and migration have separate requirements. Draft route; publication is not approved.
